summary: PulseGuard v0.6.10 restores the Optimize page live bottom progress surface and post-run report access while preserving existing diagnostics, repair, optimization, and updater behavior.

sections.heading: Optimize progress visibility
sections.detail: Live FIX + OPTIMIZE percentage and current-task status now remain visible in the large bottom status area throughout the run.

sections.heading: Report access
sections.detail: The post-run REVIEW REPORT action is restored and reliably resolves the latest consolidated report.

sections.heading: General maintenance
sections.detail: No diagnostics, repair, Hardware Health, driver, scoring, or update logic was changed in this UI hotfix.
